body: Spec F3: Hatchet sdks/go v0.107.1 has Worker.Use(MiddlewareFunc) (client.go:558-573), bridged to the deprecated v0 type. Recommendation: own middleware in the core for every driver; use Hatchet's only where it adds something.
title: Decide: whether the library uses Hatchet's Worker.Use middleware or only its own
